          children[i] = std::make_unique<Octree>();\n268\t                children[i]->allTriangles = allTriangles;\n269\t                children[i]->buildNode(childIndices[i], childMin, childMax);\n270\t            }\n271\t        }\n272\t    }\n273\t\n274\tpublic:\n275\t    // Check if a ray intersects this node's bounding box\n276\t    bool rayIntersectsBox(const Vec3& p1, const Vec3& p2) const {\n277\t        Vec3 d = (p2 - p1) * 0.5f;\n278\t        Vec3 c = p1 + d - center;\n279\t        Vec3 ad = {std::abs(d.x), std::abs(d.y), std::abs(d.z)};\n280\t\n281\t        if (std::abs(c.x) > halfExtent.x + ad.x) return false;\n282\t        if (std::abs(c.y) > halfExtent.y + ad.y) return false;\n283\t        if (std::abs(c.z) > halfExtent.z + ad.z) return false;\n284\t\n285\t        if (std::abs(d.y * c.z - d.z * c.y) > halfExtent.y * ad.z + halfExtent.z * ad.y + EPSILON) return false;\n286\t        if (std::abs(d.z * c.x - d.x * c.z) > halfExtent.z * ad.x + halfExtent.x * ad.z + EPSILON) return false;\n287\t        if (std::abs(d.x * c.y - d.y * c.x) > halfExtent.x * ad.y + halfExtent.y * ad.x + EPSILON) return false;\n288\t\n289\t        return true;\n290\t    }\n291\t\n292\t    // Apply a function to all triangles potentially intersecting the ray\n293\t    // Returns true if the function returns true for any triangle\n294\t    template<typename Func>\n295\t    bool applyToTris(const Vec3& p1, const Vec3& p2, Func&& func) const {\n296\t        // If leaf node, check triangles directly\n297\t        if (!triangleIndices.empty()) {\n298\t            for (size_t idx : triangleIndices) {\n299\t                if (func(idx, (*allTriangles)[idx])) return true;\n300\t            }\n301\t            return false;\n302\t        }\n303\t\n304\t        // Otherwise, descend to children\n305\t        for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {\n306\t            if (children[i] && children[i]->rayIntersectsBox(p1, p2)) {\n307\t                if (children[i]->applyToTris(p1, p2, func)) return true;\n308\t            }\n309\t        }\n310\t        return false;\n311\t    }\n312\t};\n313\t\n314\t// ============================================================================\n315\t// Mesh Generation: Icosphere\n316\t// ============================================================================\n317\t\n318\t// Generate an icosphere by subdividing an icosahedron\n319\tclass IcosphereMesh {\n320\tpublic:\n321\t    std::vector<Triangle> triangles;\n322\t\n323\t    IcosphereMesh(int subdivisions, val_t radius) {\n324\t        // Initial icosahedron vertices\n325\t        const val_t t = (1.0f + std::sqrt(5.0f)) / 2.0f;\n326\t\n327\t        std::vector<Vec3> vertices = {\n328\t            Vec3(-1,  t,  0).normalized() * radius,\n329\t            Vec3( 1,  t,  0).normalized() * radius,\n330\t            Vec3(-1, -t,  0).normalized() * radius,\n331\t            Vec3( 1, -t,  0).normalized() * radius,\n332\t            Vec3( 0, -1,  t).normalized() * radius,\n333\t            Vec3( 0,  1,  t).normalized() * radius,\n334\t            Vec3( 0, -1, -t).normalized() * radius,\n335\t            Vec3( 0,  1, -t).normalized() * radius,\n336\t            Vec3( t,  0, -1).normalized() * radius,\n337\t            Vec3( t,  0,  1).normalized() * radius,\n338\t            Vec3(-t,  0, -1).normalized() * radius,\n339\t            Vec3(-t,  0,  1).normalized() * radius\n340\t        };\n341\t\n342\t        // Initial icosahedron faces (20 triangles)\n343\t        std::vector<std::array<idx_t, 3>> faces = {\n344\t            {0, 11, 5}, {0, 5, 1}, {0, 1, 7}, {0, 7, 10}, {0, 10, 11},\n345\t            {1, 5, 9}, {5, 11, 4}, {11, 10, 2}, {10, 7, 6}, {7, 1, 8},\n346\t            {3, 9, 4}, {3, 4, 2}, {3, 2, 6}, {3, 6, 8}, {3, 8, 9},\n347\t            {4, 9, 5}, {2, 4, 11}, {6, 2, 10}, {8, 6, 7}, {9, 8, 1}\n348\t        };\n349\t\n350\t        // Subdivide\n351\t        for (int i = 0; i < subdivisions; ++i) {\n352\t            std::vector<std::array<idx_t, 3>> newFaces;\n353\t            std::map<std::pair<idx_t, idx_t>, idx_t> midpointCache;\n354\t\n355\t            auto getMidpoint = [&](idx_t i1, idx_t i2) -> idx_t {\n356\t                auto key = std::make_pair(std::min(i1, i2), std::max(i1, i2));\n357\t                auto it = midpointCache.find(key);\n358\t                if (it != midpointCache.end()) return it->second;\n359\t\n360\t                Vec3 mid = (vertices[i1] + vertices[i2]) / 2.0f;\n361\t                mid = mid.normalized() * radius;\n362\t                idx_t idx = static_cast<idx_t>(vertices.size());\n363\t                vertices.push_back(mid);\n364\t                midpointCache[key] = idx;\n365\t                return idx;\n366\t            };\n367\t\n368\t            for (const auto& face : faces) {\n369\t                idx_t a = getMidpoint(face[0], face[1]);\n370\t                idx_t b = getMidpoint(face[1], face[2]);\n371\t                idx_t c = getMidpoint(face[2], face[0]);\n372\t\n373\t                newFaces.push_back({face[0], a, c});\n374\t                newFaces.push_back({face[1], b, a});\n375\t                newFaces.push_back({face[2], c, b});\n376\t                newFaces.push_back({a, b, c});\n377\t            }\n378\t            faces = std::move(newFaces);\n379\t        }\n380\t\n381\t        // Build triangles (normals pointing inward for a \"room\")\n382\t        triangles.reserve(faces.size());\n383\t        for (const auto& face : faces) {\n384\t            // Reverse winding to make normals point inward\n385\t            triangles.emplace_back(vertices[face[2]], vertices[face[1]], vertices[face[0]]);\n386\t        }\n387\t    }\n388\t};\n389\t\n390\t// ============================================================================\n391\t// Random Number Generation\n392\t// ============================================================================\n393\t\n394\tclass RandomGenerator {\n395\t    std::mt19937 rng;\n396\t    std::uniform_real_distribution<val_t> dist;\n397\tpublic:\n398\t    explicit RandomGenerator(uint32_t seed = 42) : rng(seed), dist(0.0f, 1.0f) {}\n399\t    val_t rand() { return dist(rng); }\n400\t};\n401\t\n402\t// Generate a random point inside a triangle using barycentric coordinates\n403\tVec3 randomPointInTriangle(const Triangle& t, RandomGenerator& rng) {\n404\t    val_t u = rng.rand();\n405\t    val_t v = rng.rand();\n406\t    if (u + v > 1.0f) {\n407\t        u = 1.0f - u;\n408\t        v = 1.0f - v;\n409\t    }\n410\t    Vec3 ab = t.b - t.a;\n411\t    Vec3 ac = t.c - t.a;\n412\t    return t.a + ab * u + ac * v;\n413\t}\n414\t\n415\t// ============================================================================\n416\t// Ray-Triangle Intersection (Möller-Trumbore algorithm)\n417\t// ============================================================================\n418\t\n419\tval_t rayTriangleIntersect(const Vec3& orig, const Vec3& dir,\n420\t                            const Vec3& v0, const Vec3& v1, const Vec3& v2) {\n421\t    Vec3 e1 = v1 - v0;\n422\t    Vec3 e2 = v2 - v0;\n423\t    Vec3 pvec = dir.cross(e2);\n424\t    val_t det = e1.dot(pvec);\n425\t\n426\t    if (std::abs(det) < EPSILON) return std::numeric_limits<val_t>::max();\n427\t\n428\t    val_t invDet = 1.0f / det;\n429\t    Vec3 tvec = orig - v0;\n430\t    val_t u = tvec.dot(pvec) * invDet;\n431\t    if (u < 0.0f || u > 1.0f) return std::numeric_limits<val_t>::max();\n432\t\n433\t    Vec3 qvec = tvec.cross(e1);\n434\t    val_t v = dir.dot(qvec) * invDet;\n435\t    if (v < 0.0f || u + v > 1.0f) return std::numeric_limits<val_t>::max();\n436\t\n437\t    return e2.dot(qvec) * invDet;\n438\t}\n439\t\n440\t// ============================================================================\n441\t// Visibility Testing (Octree-accelerated)\n442\t// ============================================================================\n443\t\n444\t// Check if a ray between two triangles is blocked by any other triangle\n445\t// Uses octree for O(log N) instead of O(N) search\n446\tbool isRayBlocked(const Vec3& from, const Vec3& to,\n447\t                  const Octree& octree,\n448\t                  size_t srcTriIdx, size_t dstTriIdx) {\n449\t    Vec3 dir = to - from;\n450\t    val_t rayLen = dir.norm();\n451\t    if (rayLen < EPSILON) return true;\n452\t    Vec3 dirNorm = dir / rayLen;\n453\t\n454\t    return octree.applyToTris(from, to, [&](size_t idx, const Triangle& tri) {\n455\t        if (idx == srcTriIdx || idx == dstTriIdx) return false;\n456\t\n457\t        val_t dist = rayTriangleIntersect(from, dirNorm, tri.a, tri.b, tri.c);\n458\t        if (dist > EPSILON && dist < rayLen - EPSILON) {\n459\t            return true;  // Ray is blocked\n460\t        }\n461\t        return false;\n462\t    });\n463\t}\n464\t\n465\t// ============================================================================\n466\t// Form Factor Computation (Kij)\n467\t// ============================================================================\n468\t\n469\t// Compute the cosine of angle between vector and triangle normal\n470\tval_t cosPhi(const Vec3& v, const Vec3& normal) {\n471\t    val_t vNorm = v.norm();\n472\t    if (vNorm <= EPSILON) return ZERO;\n473\t    return std::max(ZERO, v.dot(normal) / vNorm);\n474\t}\n475\t\n476\t// Compute form factor Kij between triangle i (receiver) and triangle j (emitter)\n477\tval_t computeKij(size_t idxI, size_t idxJ,\n478\t                  const std::vector<Triangle>& triangles,\n479\t                  const Octree& octree,\n480\t                  RandomGenerator& rng) {\n481\t    const Triangle& triI = triangles[idxI];\n482\t    const Triangle& triJ = triangles[idxJ];\n483\t\n484\t    // Cull triangles facing the same direction\n485\t    if (triI.normal().dot(triJ.normal()) > 0.99f) return ZERO;\n486\t\n487\t    val_t kij = ZERO;\n488\t\n489\t    for (int r = 0; r < NUM_RAYS; ++r) {\n490\t        Vec3 pI = randomPointInTriangle(triI, rng);\n491\t        Vec3 pJ = randomPointInTriangle(triJ, rng);\n492\t\n493\t        if (isRayBlocked(pI, pJ, octree, idxI, idxJ)) continue;\n494\t\n495\t        Vec3 v = pJ - pI;\n496\t        val_t distSqr = v.squaredNorm();\n497\t        if (distSqr < EPSILON) continue;\n498\t\n499\t        val_t cosPhiI = cosPhi(v, triI.normal());\n500\t        val_t cosPhiJ = cosPhi(-v, triJ.normal());\n501\t\n502\t        if (cosPhiI <= ZERO || cosPhiJ <= ZERO) continue;\n503\t\n504\t        kij += (cosPhiI * cosPhiJ) / (PI * distSqr);\n505\t    }\n506\t\n507\t    return kij * INV_NUM_RAYS;\n508\t}\n509\t\n510\t// ============================================================================\n511\t// Tau (time delay) Computation\n512\t// ============================================================================\n513\t\n514\tint computeTau(const Triangle& triI, const Triangle& triJ) {\n515\t    val_t dist = (triI.center() - triJ.center()).norm();\n516\t    return static_cast<int>(std::ceil(dist * INV_WAVE_SPEED));\n517\t}\n518\t\n519\t// ============================================================================\n520\t// Room Response Simulation State\n521\t// ============================================================================\n522\t\n523\tstruct SimulationState {\n524\t    size_t numTriangles;\n525\t    size_t numTimesteps;\n526\t\n527\t    std::vector<Triangle> triangles;\n528\t    std::vector<val_t> areas;       // Area of each triangle\n529\t    std::vector<val_t> rho;         // Reflectivity (0.0 to 1.0)\n530\t    std::vector<val_t> kij;         // Form factors (N x N matrix, row-major)\n531\t    std::vector<int> tau;           // Time delays (N x N matrix, row-major)\n532\t    std::vector<val_t> radE;        // Emission radiosity (T x N matrix)\n533\t    std::vector<val_t> radB;        // Reflected radiosity (T x N matrix)\n534\t    std::vector<val_t> distances;   // Computed distances from source\n535\t\n536\t    Octree octree;                  // Spatial acceleration structure\n537\t\n538\t    size_t sourceIndex;\n539\t\n540\t    size_t idx2d(size_t i, size_t j) const { return i * numTriangles + j; }\n541\t    size_t idxTN(size_t t, size_t n) const { return t * numTriangles + n; }\n542\t};\n543\t\n544\t// ============================================================================\n545\t// Initialization\n546\t// ============================================================================\n547\t\n548\tvoid initializeSimulation(SimulationState& state, int subdivisions, size_t timesteps,\n549\t                          size_t sourceIdx, val_t reflectivity) {\n550\t    // Generate mesh\n551\t    IcosphereMesh mesh(subdivisions, 10.0f);  // Radius 10 units\n552\t    state.triangles = std::move(mesh.triangles);\n553\t    state.numTriangles = state.triangles.size();\n554\t    state.numTimesteps = timesteps;\n555\t    state.sourceIndex = sourceIdx % state.numTriangles;\n556\t\n557\t    printf(\"Generated icosphere mesh with %zu triangles\\n\", state.numTriangles);\n558\t\n559\t    // Build octree for spatial acceleration\n560\t    printf(\"Building octree...\\n\");\n561\t    state.octree.build(state.triangles);\n562\t\n563\t    // Initialize areas\n564\t    state.areas.resize(state.numTriangles);\n565\t    for (size_t i = 0; i ZERO);\n578\t\n579\t    // Set source emission (active for first half of timesteps)\n580\t    size_t timeOn = 0;\n581\t    size_t timeOff = timesteps / 2;\n582\t    for (size_t t = timeOn; t < timeOff; ++t) {\n583\t        state.radE[state.idxTN(t, state.sourceIndex)] = 1.0f;\n584\t    }\n585\t}\n586\t\n587\t// ============================================================================\n588\t// Precomputation Phase\n589\t// ============================================================================\n590\t\n591\tvoid computeFormFactors(SimulationState& state) {\n592\t    printf(\"Computing form factors (Kij)...\\n\");\n593\t    RandomGenerator rng(42);\n594\t\n595\t    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n596\t        for (size_t j = 0; j < state.numTriangles; ++j) {\n597\t            if (i == j) continue;\n598\t            state.kij[state.idx2d(i, j)] = computeKij(\n599\t                i, j, state.triangles, state.octree, rng);\n600\t        }\n601\t        if ((i + 1) % 100 == 0 || i + 1 == state.numTriangles) {\n602\t            printf(\"  Progress: %zu/%zu triangles\\n\", i + 1, state.numTriangles);\n603\t        }\n604\t    }\n605\t}\n606\t\n607\tvoid computeTimeDelays(SimulationState& state) {\n608\t    printf(\"Computing time delays (Tau)...\\n\");\n609\t\n610\t    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n611\t        for (size_t j = 0; j < state.numTriangles; ++j) {\n612\t            if (i == j) continue;\n613\t            state.tau[state.idx2d(i, j)] = computeTau(\n614\t                state.triangles[i], state.triangles[j]);\n615\t        }\n616\t    }\n617\t}\n618\t\n619\t// ============================================================================\n620\t// Simulation Phase (Wave Propagation)\n621\t// ============================================================================\n622\t\n623\tvoid runSimulation(SimulationState& state) {\n624\t    printf(\"Running wave propagation simulation...\\n\");\n625\t\n626\t    for (size_t t = 0; t < state.numTimesteps; ++t) {\n627\t        for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n628\t            val_t sumB = ZERO;\n629\t\n630\t            for (size_t j = 0; j < state.numTriangles; ++j) {\n631\t                if (i == j) continue;\n632\t\n633\t                int tauij = state.tau[state.idx2d(i, j)];\n634\t\n635\t                // Skip if wave hasn't yet propagated from j to i\n636\t                if (static_cast<int>(t) < tauij) continue;\n637\t\n638\t                val_t kij = state.kij[state.idx2d(i, j)];\n639\t                if (kij <= ZERO) continue;\n640\t\n641\t                // Get radiosity from source triangle at time when emission occurred\n642\t                size_t srcTime = t - static_cast<size_t>(tauij);\n643\t                val_t radJ = state.radB[state.idxTN(srcTime, j)];\n644\t                if (radJ <= ZERO) continue;\n645\t\n646\t                // Accumulate contribution: form factor * area * source radiosity\n647\t                sumB += std::min(kij * state.areas[j], ONE) * radJ;\n648\t            }\n649\t\n650\t            // Update radiosity: reflection + emission\n651\t            state.radB[state.idxTN(t, i)] = state.rho[i] * sumB + state.radE[state.idxTN(t, i)];\n652\t        }\n653\t\n654\t        if ((t + 1) % 10 == 0 || t + 1 == state.numTimesteps) {\n655\t            printf(\"  Timestep %zu/%zu\\n\", t + 1, state.numTimesteps);\n656\t        }\n657\t    }\n658\t}\n659\t\n660\t// ============================================================================\n661\t// Distance Computation (Cross-Correlation)\n662\t// ============================================================================\n663\t\n664\tvoid computeDistances(SimulationState& state) {\n665\t    printf(\"Computing distances via cross-correlation...\\n\");\n666\t\n667\t    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n668\t        val_t maxCorr = ZERO;\n669\t        int bestT = 0;\n670\t\n671\t        // Discrete cross-correlation to find time delay\n672\t        for (size_t t = 0; t < state.numTimesteps; ++t) {\n673\t            val_t sum = ZERO;\n674\t\n675\t            for (size_t tt = t; tt < state.numTimesteps; ++tt) {\n676\t                val_t pB = state.radB[state.idxTN(tt, i)];\n677\t                val_t pS = state.radB[state.idxTN(tt - t, state.sourceIndex)];\n678\t                sum += pS * pB;\n679\t            }\n680\t\n681\t            if (sum > maxCorr) {\n682\t                maxCorr = sum;\n683\t                bestT = static_cast<int>(t);\n684\t            }\n685\t        }\n686\t\n687\t        state.distances[i] = WAVE_SPEED * static_cast<val_t>(bestT);\n688\t    }\n689\t}\n690\t\n691\t// ============================================================================\n692\t// Validation\n693\t// ============================================================================\n694\t\n695\tbool validateResults(const SimulationState& state) {\n696\t    printf(\"\\nValidation:\\n\");\n697\t\n698\t    // Check that distances are non-negative\n699\t    bool allNonNegative = true;\n700\t    val_t minDist = std::numeric_limits<val_t>::max();\n701\t    val_t maxDist = std::numeric_limits<val_t>::lowest();\n702\t    val_t sumDist = ZERO;\n703\t    int nonZeroCount = 0;\n704\t\n705\t    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n706\t        val_t d = state.distances[i];\n707\t        if (d < 0) {\n708\t            allNonNegative = false;\n709\t            printf(\"  ERROR: Negative distance at triangle %zu: %f\\n\", i, d);\n710\t        }\n711\t        if (!std::isfinite(d)) {\n712\t            printf(\"  ERROR: Non-finite distance at triangle %zu: %f\\n\", i, d);\n713\t            return false;\n714\t        }\n715\t        minDist = std::min(minDist, d);\n716\t        maxDist = std::max(maxDist, d);\n717\t        sumDist += d;\n718\t        if (d > EPSILON) nonZeroCount++;\n719\t    }\n720\t\n721\t    printf(\"  Distance range: [%.4f, %.4f]\\n\", minDist, maxDist);\n722\t    printf(\"  Average distance: %.4f\\n\", sumDist / static_cast<val_t>(state.numTriangles));\n723\t    printf(\"  Non-zero distances: %d/%zu\\n\", nonZeroCount, state.numTriangles);\n724\t\n725\t    // Check source distance is zero or very small\n726\t    val_t srcDist = state.distances[state.sourceIndex];\n727\t    if (srcDist > WAVE_SPEED * 2) {\n728\t        printf(\"  WARNING: Source triangle distance is non-zero: %.4f\\n\", srcDist);\n729\t    }\n730\t\n731\t    // Check radiosity propagation (some triangles should have received energy)\n732\t    int receivedEnergy = 0;\n733\t    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n734\t        for (size_t t = 0; t < state.numTimesteps; ++t) {\n735\t            if (state.radB[state.idxTN(t, i)] > EPSILON) {\n736\t                receivedEnergy++;\n737\t                break;\n738\t            }\n739\t        }\n740\t    }\n741\t\n742\t    printf(\"  Triangles receiving energy: %d/%zu\\n\", receivedEnergy, state.numTriangles);\n743\t\n744\t    if (receivedEnergy == 0) {\n745\t        printf(\"  ERROR: No triangles received energy - simulation failed\\n\");\n746\t        return false;\n747\t    }\n748\t\n749\t    // Check Kij matrix (should have some non-zero entries)\n750\t    int nonZeroKij = 0;\n751\t    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles * state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n752\t        if (state.kij[i] > EPSILON) nonZeroKij++;\n753\t    }\n754\t    printf(\"  Non-zero form factors: %d/%zu (%.2f%%)\\n\",\n755\t           nonZeroKij, state.numTriangles * state.numTriangles,\n756\t           100.0f * nonZeroKij / static_cast<val_t>(state.numTriangles * state.numTriangles));\n757\t\n758\t    if (nonZeroKij == 0) {\n759\t        printf(\"  ERROR: All form factors are zero - visibility computation failed\\n\");\n760\t        return false;\n761\t    }\n762\t\n763\t    if (!allNonNegative) {\n764\t        return false;\n765\t    }\n766\t\n767\t    printf(\"  Validation: PASSED\\n\");\n768\t    return true;\n769\t}\n770\t\n771\t// ============================================================================\n772\t// Hash for Verification\n773\t// ============================================================================\n\n// Check if a ray between two triangles is blocked by any other triangle\n// Uses octree for O(log N) instead of O(N) search\nbool isRayBlocked(const Vec3& from, const Vec3& to,\n                  const Octree& octree,\n                  size_t srcTriIdx, size_t dstTriIdx) {\n    Vec3 dir = to - from;\n    val_t static_cast<idx_t>(vertices.size());\n                vertices.push_back(mid);\n                midpointCache[key] = idx;\n                return idx;\n            };\n\n            for (const auto& face : faces) {\n                idx_t a = getMidpoint(face[0], face[1]);\n                idx_t b = getMidpoint(face[1], face[2]);\n                idx_t c = getMidpoint(face[2], face[0]);\n\n                newFaces.push_back({face[0], a, c});\n                newFaces.push_back({face[1], b, a});\n                newFaces.push_back({face[2], c, b});\n                newFaces.push_back({a, b, c});\n            }\n            faces = std::move(newFaces);\n        }\n\n        // Build triangles (normals pointing inward for a \"room\")\n        triangles.reserve(faces.size());\n        for (const auto& face : faces) {\n            // Reverse winding to make normals point inward\n            triangles.emplace_back(vertices[face[2]], vertices[face[1]], vertices[face[0]]);\n        }\n    }\n};\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Random Number Generation (counter-based, deterministic under parallelism)\n// ============================================================================\n\n// Stateless splitmix64 hash: every (i, j, ray, component) tuple maps to an\n// independent uniform value, so the Monte-Carlo sampling is identical\n// regardless of how the (i, j) pairs are distributed over ranks/threads/GPUs.\n__host__ __device__ inline uint64_t splitmix64(uint64_t x) {\n    x += 0x9E3779B97F4A7C15ULL;\n    x = (x ^ (x >> 30)) * 0xBF58476D1CE4E5B9ULL;\n    x = (x ^ (x >> 27)) * 0x94D049BB133111EBULL;\n    return x ^ (x >> 31);\n}\n\n__host__ __device__ inline val_t rand01(uint64_t key) {\n    // Top 24 bits -> uniform float in [0, 1)\n    return static_cast<val_t>(splitmix64(key) >> 40) * (1.0f / 16777216.0f);\n}\n\n// Generate a point inside a triangle from two uniform samples (barycentric)\n__host__ __device__ inline Vec3 pointInTriangle(const Triangle& t, val_t u, val_t v) {\n    if (u + v > 1.0f) {\n        u = 1.0f - u;\n        v = 1.0f - v;\n    }\n    Vec3 ab = t.b - t.a;\n    Vec3 ac = t.c - t.a;\n    return t.a + ab * u + ac * v;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Ray-Triangle Intersection (Möller-Trumbore algorithm)\n// ============================================================================\n\n__host__ __device__ val_t rayTriangleIntersect(const Vec3& orig, const Vec3& dir,\n                                               const Vec3& v0, const Vec3& v1, const Vec3& v2) {\n    Vec3 e1 = v1 - v0;\n    Vec3 e2 = v2 - v0;\n    Vec3 pvec = dir.cross(e2);\n    val_t det = e1.dot(pvec);\n\n    if (fabsf(det) < EPSILON) return FLT_MAX;\n\n    val_t invDet = 1.0f / det;\n    Vec3 tvec = orig - v0;\n    val_t u = tvec.dot(pvec) * invDet;\n    if (u < 0.0f || u > 1.0f) return FLT_MAX;\n\n    Vec3 qvec = tvec.cross(e1);\n    val_t v = dir.dot(qvec) * invDet;\n    if (v < 0.0f || u + v > 1.0f) return FLT_MAX;\n\n    return e2.dot(qvec) * invDet;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Visibility Testing (flattened-octree traversal on the GPU)\n// ============================================================================\n\n// Segment-box overlap test against a flattened octree node's AABB\n__device__ inline bool rayIntersectsNode(const GpuNode& n, const Vec3& p1, const Vec3& p2) {\n    Vec3 center{n.cx, n.cy, n.cz};\n    Vec3 halfExtent{n.hx, n.hy, n.hz};\n\n    Vec3 d = (p2 - p1) * 0.5f;\n    Vec3 c = p1 + d - center;\n    Vec3 ad = {fabsf(d.x), fabsf(d.y), fabsf(d.z)};\n\n    if (fabsf(c.x) > halfExtent.x + ad.x) return false;\n    if (fabsf(c.y) > halfExtent.y + ad.y) return false;\n    if (fabsf(c.z) > halfExtent.z + ad.z) return false;\n\n    if (fabsf(d.y * c.z - d.z * c.y) > halfExtent.y * ad.z + halfExtent.z * ad.y + EPSILON) return false;\n    if (fabsf(d.z * c.x - d.x * c.z) > halfExtent.z * ad.x + halfExtent.x * ad.z + EPSILON) return false;\n    if (fabsf(d.x * c.y - d.y * c.x) > halfExtent.x * ad.y + halfExtent.y * ad.x + EPSILON) return false;\n\n    return true;\n}\n\n// Check if a ray between two triangles is blocked by any other triangle,\n// using an explicit-stack traversal of the flattened octree.\n__device__ bool isRayBlocked(const Vec3& from, const Vec3& to,\n                             const GpuNode* nodes, const int* triIdx,\n                             const Triangle* triangles,\n                             int srcTriIdx, int dstTriIdx) {\n    Vec3 dir = to - from;\n    val_t rayLen = dir.norm();\n    if (rayLen < EPSILON) return true;\n    Vec3 dirNorm = dir / rayLen;\n\n    int stack[96];\n    int sp = 0;\n    stack[sp++] = 0;  // root\n\n    while (sp > 0) {\n        const GpuNode& n = nodes[stack[--sp]];\n\n        if (n.triCount > 0) {\n            // Leaf: test triangles directly\n            for (int k = 0; k < n.triCount; ++k) {\n                int idx = triIdx[n.triStart + k];\n                if (idx == srcTriIdx || idx == dstTriIdx) continue;\n\n                const Triangle& tri = triangles[idx];\n                val_t dist = rayTriangleIntersect(from, dirNorm, tri.a, tri.b, tri.c);\n                if (dist > EPSILON && dist < rayLen - EPSILON) {\n                    return true;  // Ray is blocked\n                }\n            }\n        } else {\n            // Internal node: descend into children whose boxes the ray hits\n            for (int cIdx = 0; cIdx < 8; ++cIdx) {\n                int ci = n.child[cIdx];\n                if (ci >= 0 && rayIntersectsNode(nodes[ci], from, to)) {\n                    stack[sp++] = ci;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    return false;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Form Factor Computation (Kij) - CUDA kernel\n// ============================================================================\n\n// Compute the cosine of angle between vector and triangle normal\n__host__ __device__ inline val_t cosPhi(const Vec3& v, const Vec3& normal) {\n    val_t vNorm = v.norm();\n    if (vNorm <= EPSILON) return ZERO;\n    return fmaxf(ZERO, v.dot(normal) / vNorm);\n}\n\n// One thread per (i, j) pair; this rank handles global rows\n// [rowStart, rowStart + numRows).\n__global__ void kijKernel(const Triangle* __restrict__ triangles, int numTriangles,\n                          int rowStart, int numRows,\n                          const GpuNode* __restrict__ nodes,\n                          const int* __restrict__ triIdx,\n                          val_t* __restrict__ kijLocal) {\n    long long tid = static_cast<long long>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;\n    long long total = static_cast<long long>(numRows) * numTriangles;\n    if (tid >= total) return;\n\n    int il = static_cast<int>(tid / numTriangles);\n    int j = static_cast<int>(tid % numTriangles);\n    int i = rowStart + il;\n\n    if (i == j) {\n        kijLocal[tid] = ZERO;\n        return;\n    }\n\n    const Triangle triI = triangles[i];\n    const Triangle triJ = triangles[j];\n\n    // Cull triangles facing the same direction\n    if (triI.normal().dot(triJ.normal()) > 0.99f) {\n        kijLocal[tid] = ZERO;\n        return;\n    }\n\n    val_t kij = ZERO;\n    const uint64_t pairKey =\n        (static_cast<uint64_t>(i) * static_cast<uint64_t>(numTriangles) +\n         static_cast<uint64_t>(j)) * (4ULL * NUM_RAYS);\n\n    for (int r = 0; r < NUM_RAYS; ++r) {\n        uint64_t rayKey = pairKey + 4ULL * r;\n        Vec3 pI = pointInTriangle(triI, rand01(rayKey + 0), rand01(rayKey + 1));\n        Vec3 pJ = pointInTriangle(triJ, rand01(rayKey + 2), rand01(rayKey + 3));\n\n        if (isRayBlocked(pI, pJ, nodes, triIdx, triangles, i, j)) continue;\n\n        Vec3 v = pJ - pI;\n        val_t distSqr = v.squaredNorm();\n        if (distSqr < EPSILON) continue;\n\n        val_t cosPhiI = cosPhi(v, triI.normal());\n        val_t cosPhiJ = cosPhi(-v, triJ.normal());\n\n        if (cosPhiI <= ZERO || cosPhiJ <= ZERO) continue;\n\n        kij += (cosPhiI * cosPhiJ) / (PI * distSqr);\n    }\n\n    kijLocal[tid] = kij * INV_NUM_RAYS;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Tau (time delay) Computation (host, OpenMP)\n// ============================================================================\n\nint computeTau(const Triangle& triI, const Triangle& triJ) {\n    val_t dist = (triI.center() - triJ.center()).norm();\n    return static_cast<int>(std::ceil(dist * INV_WAVE_SPEED));\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Simulation Kernel (Wave Propagation) - one block per local triangle row\n// ============================================================================\n\nconstexpr int SIM_BLOCK = 256;\n\n__global__ void simStepKernel(const val_t* __restrict__ kijLocal,\n                              const int* __restrict__ tauLocal,\n                              const val_t* __restrict__ areas,\n                              const val_t* __restrict__ rho,\n                              const val_t* __restrict__ radE,\n                              val_t* __restrict__ radB,\n                              int numTriangles, int rowStart, int t) {\n    int il = blockIdx.x;\n    int i = rowStart + il;\n\n    const val_t* kRow = kijLocal + static_cast<size_t>(il) * numTriangles;\n    const int* tRow = tauLocal + static_cast<size_t>(il) * numTriangles;\n\n    val_t sum = ZERO;\n    for (int j = threadIdx.x; j < numTriangles; j += blockDim.x) {\n        if (j == i) continue;\n\n        int tauij = tRow[j];\n\n        // Skip if wave hasn't yet propagated from j to i (tau >= 1 for i != j,\n        // so only rows < t of radB are read here)\n        if (t < tauij) continue;\n\n        val_t kij = kRow[j];\n        if (kij <= ZERO) continue;\n\n        // Get radiosity from source triangle at time when emission occurred\n        val_t radJ = radB[static_cast<size_t>(t - tauij) * numTriangles + j];\n        if (radJ <= ZERO) continue;\n\n        // Accumulate contribution: form factor * area * source radiosity\n        sum += fminf(kij * areas[j], ONE) * radJ;\n    }\n\n    __shared__ val_t sdata[SIM_BLOCK];\n    sdata[threadIdx.x] = sum;\n    __syncthreads();\n    for (int s = blockDim.x / 2; s > 0; s >>= 1) {\n        if (threadIdx.x < s) sdata[threadIdx.x] += sdata[threadIdx.x + s];\n        __syncthreads();\n    }\n\n    // Update radiosity: reflection + emission\n    if (threadIdx.x == 0) {\n        radB[static_cast<size_t>(t) * numTriangles + i] =\n            rho[i] * sdata[0] + radE[static_cast<size_t>(t) * numTriangles + i];\n    }\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Distance Kernels (Cross-Correlation)\n// ============================================================================\n\n// One thread per (local row, lag): discrete cross-correlation against the\n// source triangle's radiosity time series.\n__global__ void corrKernel(const val_t* __restrict__ radB,\n                           int numTriangles, int numTimesteps,\n                           int rowStart, int numRows, int sourceIndex,\n                           val_t* __restrict__ corr) {\n    long long tid = static_cast<long long>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;\n    long long total = static_cast<long long>(numRows) * numTimesteps;\n    if (tid >= total) return;\n\n    int il = static_cast<int>(tid / numTimesteps);\n    int t = static_cast<int>(tid % numTimesteps);\n    int i = rowStart + il;\n\n    val_t sum = ZERO;\n    for (int tt = t; tt < numTimesteps; ++tt) {\n        val_t pB = radB[static_cast<size_t>(tt) * numTriangles + i];\n        val_t pS = radB[static_cast<size_t>(tt - t) * numTriangles + sourceIndex];\n        sum += pS * pB;\n    }\n    corr[tid] = sum;\n}\n\n// One thread per local row: pick the earliest lag with the strictly largest\n// correlation (same tie-breaking as the sequential code).\n__global__ void argmaxKernel(const val_t* __restrict__ corr, int numTimesteps,\n                             int numRows, val_t* __restrict__ distLocal) {\n    int il = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;\n    if (il >= numRows) return;\n\n    const val_t* row = corr + static_cast<size_t>(il) * numTimesteps;\n    val_t maxCorr = ZERO;\n    int bestT = 0;\n    for (int t = 0; t < numTimesteps; ++t) {\n        if (row[t] > maxCorr) {\n            maxCorr = row[t];\n            bestT = t;\n        }\n    }\n    distLocal[il] = WAVE_SPEED * static_cast<val_t>(bestT);\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Room Response Simulation State\n// ============================================================================\n\nstruct SimulationState {\n    size_t numTriangles;\n    size_t numTimesteps;\n\n    std::vector<Triangle> triangles;\n    std::vector<val_t> areas;       // Area of each triangle\n    std::vector<val_t> rho;         // Reflectivity (0.0 to 1.0)\n    std::vector<val_t> kij;         // Form factors (local rows x N, row-major)\n    std::vector<int> tau;           // Time delays (local rows x N, row-major)\n    std::vector<val_t> radE;        // Emission radiosity (T x N matrix)\n    std::vector<val_t> radB;        // Reflected radiosity (T x N matrix, full copy)\n    std::vector<val_t> distances;   // Computed distances from source (full)\n\n    Octree octree;                  // Spatial acceleration structure\n\n    size_t sourceIndex;\n\n    // MPI decomposition: this rank owns global rows [rowStart, rowStart+rowCount)\n    int mpiRank = 0;\n    int mpiSize = 1;\n    int rowStart = 0;\n    int rowCount = 0;\n    std::vector<int> rowCounts;     // per-rank row counts\n    std::vector<int> rowDispls;     // per-rank row offsets\n\n    // Device buffers (one GPU per rank)\n    Triangle* dTriangles = nullptr;\n    GpuNode* dNodes = nullptr;\n    int* dTriIdx = nullptr;\n    val_t* dAreas = nullptr;\n    val_t* dRho = nullptr;\n    val_t* dKij = nullptr;          // local rows x N\n    int* dTau = nullptr;            // local rows x N\n    val_t* dRadE = nullptr;         // T x N\n    val_t* dRadB = nullptr;         // T x N\n    val_t* dCorr = nullptr;         // local rows x T\n    val_t* dDist = nullptr;         // local rows\n\n    size_t idxLocal2d(size_t il, size_t j) const { return il * numTriangles + j; }\n    size_t idxTN(size_t t, size_t n) const { return t * numTriangles + n; }\n};\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Initialization\n// ============================================================================\n\nvoid initializeSimulation(SimulationState& state, int subdivisions, size_t timesteps,\n                          size_t sourceIdx, val_t reflectivity) {\n    const bool root = (state.mpiRank == 0);\n\n    // Generate mesh (deterministic, so every rank builds an identical copy)\n    IcosphereMesh mesh(subdivisions, 10.0f);  // Radius 10 units\n    state.triangles = std::move(mesh.triangles);\n    state.numTriangles = state.triangles.size();\n    state.numTimesteps = timesteps;\n    state.sourceIndex = sourceIdx % state.numTriangles;\n\n    if (root) printf(\"Generated icosphere mesh with %zu triangles\\n\", state.numTriangles);\n\n    // Block-distribute triangle rows across MPI ranks\n    int n = static_cast<int>(state.numTriangles);\n    int base = n / state.mpiSize;\n    int rem = n % state.mpiSize;\n    state.rowCounts.resize(state.mpiSize);\n    state.rowDispls.resize(state.mpiSize);\n    for (int r = 0; r < state.mpiSize; ++r) {\n        state.rowCounts[r] = base + (r < rem ? 1 : 0);\n        state.rowDispls[r] = r * base + std::min(r, rem);\n    }\n    state.rowStart = state.rowDispls[state.mpiRank];\n    state.rowCount = state.rowCounts[state.mpiRank];\n\n    // Build octree for spatial acceleration\n    if (root) printf(\"Building octree...\\n\");\n    state.octree.build(state.triangles);\n\n    // Initialize areas\n    state.areas.resize(state.numTriangles);\n    #pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n        state.areas[i] = state.triangles[i].area();\n    }\n\n    // Initialize reflectivity\n    state.rho.resize(state.numTriangles, reflectivity);\n\n    // Initialize matrices (Kij and Tau hold only this rank's rows)\n    state.kij.resize(static_cast<size_t>(state.rowCount) * state.numTriangles, ZERO);\n    state.tau.resize(static_cast<size_t>(state.rowCount) * state.numTriangles, 0);\n    state.radE.resize(timesteps * state.numTriangles, ZERO);\n    state.radB.resize(timesteps * state.numTriangles, ZERO);\n    state.distances.resize(state.numTriangles, ZERO);\n\n    // Set source emission (active for first half of timesteps)\n    size_t timeOn = 0;\n    size_t timeOff = timesteps / 2;\n    for (size_t t = timeOn; t < timeOff; ++t) {\n        state.radE[state.idxTN(t, state.sourceIndex)] = 1.0f;\n    }\n}\n\n// Upload static data and allocate working buffers on this rank's GPU\nvoid setupDevice(SimulationState& state) {\n    size_t n = state.numTriangles;\n    size_t t = state.numTimesteps;\n    size_t localRows = static_cast<size_t>(state.rowCount);\n\n    // Flatten octree for GPU traversal\n    std::vector<GpuNode> nodes;\n    std::vector<int> triIdx;\n    flattenOctree(state.octree, nodes, triIdx);\n\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&state.dTriangles, n * sizeof(Triangle)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&state.dNodes, nodes.size() * sizeof(GpuNode)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&state.dTriIdx, std::max<size_t>(triIdx.size(), 1) * sizeof(int)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&state.dAreas, n * sizeof(val_t)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&state.dRho, n * sizeof(val_t)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&state.dKij, std::max<size_t>(localRows * n, 1) * sizeof(val_t)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&state.dTau, std::max<size_t>(localRows * n, 1) * sizeof(int)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&state.dRadE, t * n * sizeof(val_t)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&state.dRadB, t * n * sizeof(val_t)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&state.dCorr, std::max<size_t>(localRows * t, 1) * sizeof(val_t)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&state.dDist, std::max<size_t>(localRows, 1) * sizeof(val_t)));\n\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(state.dTriangles, state.triangles.data(),\n                          n * sizeof(Triangle), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(state.dNodes, nodes.data(),\n                          nodes.size() * sizeof(GpuNode), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n    if (!triIdx.empty()) {\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(state.dTriIdx, triIdx.data(),\n                              triIdx.size() * sizeof(int), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n    }\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(state.dAreas, state.areas.data(),\n                          n * sizeof(val_t), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(state.dRho, state.rho.data(),\n                          n * sizeof(val_t), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(state.dRadE, state.radE.data(),\n                          t * n * sizeof(val_t), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemset(state.dRadB, 0, t * n * sizeof(val_t)));\n}\n\nvoid teardownDevice(SimulationState& state) {\n    cudaFree(state.dTriangles);\n    cudaFree(state.dNodes);\n    cudaFree(state.dTriIdx);\n    cudaFree(state.dAreas);\n    cudaFree(state.dRho);\n    cudaFree(state.dKij);\n    cudaFree(state.dTau);\n    cudaFree(state.dRadE);\n    cudaFree(state.dRadB);\n    cudaFree(state.dCorr);\n    cudaFree(state.dDist);\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Precomputation Phase\n// ============================================================================\n\n// Form factors for this rank's rows on the GPU\nvoid computeFormFactors(SimulationState& state) {\n    if (state.mpiRank == 0) printf(\"Computing form factors (Kij)...\\n\");\n\n    long long total = static_cast<long long>(state.rowCount) * state.numTriangles;\n    if (total > 0) {\n        int threads = 128;\n        long long blocks = (total + threads - 1) / threads;\n        kijKernel<<<static_cast<unsigned int>(blocks), threads>>>(\n            state.dTriangles, static_cast<int>(state.numTriangles),\n            state.rowStart, state.rowCount,\n            state.dNodes, state.dTriIdx, state.dKij);\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaDeviceSynchronize());\n\n        // Keep a host copy of the local rows for validation statistics\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(state.kij.data(), state.dKij,\n                              total * sizeof(val_t), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));\n    }\n\n    if (state.mpiRank == 0) {\n        printf(\"  Progress: %zu/%zu triangles\\n\", state.numTriangles, state.numTriangles);\n    }\n}\n\n// Time delays for this rank's rows on the host (OpenMP), then uploaded\nvoid computeTimeDelays(SimulationState& state) {\n    if (state.mpiRank == 0) printf(\"Computing time delays (Tau)...\\n\");\n\n    #pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)\n    for (int il = 0; il < state.rowCount; ++il) {\n        size_t i = static_cast<size_t>(state.rowStart + il);\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < state.numTriangles; ++j) {\n            if (i == j) continue;\n            state.tau[state.idxLocal2d(il, j)] = computeTau(\n                state.triangles[i], state.triangles[j]);\n        }\n    }\n\n    if (state.rowCount > 0) {\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(state.dTau, state.tau.data(),\n                              static_cast<size_t>(state.rowCount) * state.numTriangles * sizeof(int),\n                              cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n    }\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Simulation Phase (Wave Propagation)\n// ============================================================================\n\nvoid runSimulation(SimulationState& state) {\n    const bool root = (state.mpiRank == 0);\n    if (root) printf(\"Running wave propagation simulation...\\n\");\n\n    int n = static_cast<int>(state.numTriangles);\n    std::vector<val_t> localRow(std::max(state.rowCount, 1));\n    std::vector<val_t> fullRow(state.numTriangles);\n\n    for (size_t t = 0; t < state.numTimesteps; ++t) {\n        // Each rank computes radB(t, i) for its own rows on the GPU. Only\n        // radB rows < t are read (tau >= 1 for i != j), so all inputs are\n        // fully synchronized history.\n        if (state.rowCount > 0) {\n            simStepKernel<<<state.rowCount, SIM_BLOCK>>>(\n                state.dKij, state.dTau, state.dAreas, state.dRho,\n                state.dRadE, state.dRadB, n, state.rowStart, static_cast<int>(t));\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(localRow.data(),\n                                  state.dRadB + t * state.numTriangles + state.rowStart,\n                                  state.rowCount * sizeof(val_t), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));\n        }\n\n        // Exchange the freshly computed radiosity row so every rank (and its\n        // GPU) holds the complete history for subsequent timesteps.\n        MPI_Allgatherv(localRow.data(), state.rowCount, MPI_FLOAT,\n                       fullRow.data(), state.rowCounts.data(), state.rowDispls.data(),\n                       MPI_FLOAT, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n\n        std::memcpy(&state.radB[state.idxTN(t, 0)], fullRow.data(), n * sizeof(val_t));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(state.dRadB + t * state.numTriangles, fullRow.data(),\n                              n * sizeof(val_t), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n\n        if (root && ((t + 1) % 10 == 0 || t + 1 == state.numTimesteps)) {\n            printf(\"  Timestep %zu/%zu\\n\", t + 1, state.numTimesteps);\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Distance Computation (Cross-Correlation)\n// ============================================================================\n\nvoid computeDistances(SimulationState& state) {\n    if (state.mpiRank == 0) printf(\"Computing distances via cross-correlation...\\n\");\n\n    int n = static_cast<int>(state.numTriangles);\n    int T = static_cast<int>(state.numTimesteps);\n\n    std::vector<val_t> localDist(std::max(state.rowCount, 1));\n\n    if (state.rowCount > 0) {\n        long long total = static_cast<long long>(state.rowCount) * T;\n        int threads = 256;\n        long long blocks = (total + threads - 1) / threads;\n        corrKernel<<<static_cast<unsigned int>(blocks), threads>>>(\n            state.dRadB, n, T, state.rowStart, state.rowCount,\n return;\n        }\n\n        // Subdivide into 8 children\n        Vec3 childHalfSize = halfExtent * 0.5f;\n        std::vector<size_t> childIndices[8];\n\n        for (size_t idx : indices) {\n            const Triangle& tri = (*allTriangles)[idx];\n\n            // Check which children this triangle overlaps\n            for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {\n                Vec3 childCenter = center;\n                childCenter.x += (i & 1) ? childHalfSize.x : -childHalfSize.x;\n                childCenter.y += (i & 2) ? childHalfSize.y : -childHalfSize.y;\n                childCenter.z += (i & 4) ? childHalfSize.z : -childHalfSize.z;\n\n                if (triangleBoxOverlap(childCenter, childHalfSize, tri)) {\n                    childIndices[i].push_back(idx);\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        // Check if we can't split further (all triangles in one child)\n        bool canSplit = false;\n        for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {\n            if (!childIndices[i].empty() && childIndices[i].size() < indices.size()) {\n                canSplit = true;\n                break;\n            }\n        }\n\n        if (!canSplit) {\n            triangleIndices = indices;\n            return;\n        }\n\n        // Build children\n        for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {\n            if (!childIndices[i].empty()) {\n                Vec3 childMin = center;\n                Vec3 childMax = center;\n                childMin.x = (i & 1) ? center.x : minBound.x;\n                childMax.x = (i & 1) ? maxBound.x : center.x;\n                childMin.y = (i & 2) ? center.y : minBound.y;\n                childMax.y = (i & 2) ? maxBound.y : center.y;\n                childMin.z = (i & 4) ? center.z : minBound.z;\n                childMax.z = (i & 4) ? maxBound.z : center.z;\n\n                children[i] = std::make_unique<Octree>();\n                children[i]->allTriangles = allTriangles;\n                children[i]->buildNode(childIndices[i], childMin, childMax);\n            }\n        }\n    }\n};\n\n// Flattened octree node for GPU traversal. A node is a leaf iff triCount > 0\n// (mirroring the host octree, where only leaves hold triangle indices).\nstruct GpuNode {\n    val_t cx, cy, cz;   // center\n    val_t hx, hy, hz;   // half extent\n    int child[8];       // child node indices, -1 if absent\n    int triStart;       // offset into triangle index array\n    int triCount;       // number of triangle indices (0 for internal nodes)\n};\n\nstatic int flattenOctree(const Octree& node, std::vector<GpuNode>& nodes,\n                         std::vector<int>& triIdx) {\n    int myIdx = static_cast<int>(nodes.size());\n    nodes.emplace_back();\n\n    GpuNode gn{};\n    gn.cx = node.center.x; gn.cy = node.center.y; gn.cz = node.center.z;\n    gn.hx = node.halfExtent.x; gn.hy = node.halfExtent.y; gn.hz = node.halfExtent.z;\n    gn.triStart = static_cast<int>(triIdx.size());\n    gn.triCount = static_cast<int>(node.triangleIndices.size());\n    for (size_t t : node.triangleIndices) triIdx.push_back(static_cast<int>(t));\n    for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) gn.child[i] = -1;\n    nodes[myIdx] = gn;\n\n    for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {\n        if (node.children[i]) {\n            int c = flattenOctree(*node.children[i], nodes, triIdx);\n            nodes[myIdx].child[i] = c;\n        }\n    }\n    return myIdx;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Mesh Generation: Icosphere\n// ============================================================================\n\n// Generate an icosphere by subdividing an icosahedron\nclass IcosphereMesh {\npublic:\n    std::vector<Triangle> triangles;\n\n    IcosphereMesh(int subdivisions, val_t radius) {\n        // Initial icosahedron vertices\n        const val_t t = (1.0f + std::sqrt(5.0f)) / 2.0f;\n\n        std::vector<Vec3> vertices = {\n            Vec3(-1,  t,  0).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( 1,  t,  0).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3(-1, -t,  0).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( 1, -t,  0).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( 0, -1,  t).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( 0,  1,  t).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( 0, -1, -t).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( 0,  1, -t).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( t,  0, -1).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( t,  0,  1).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3(-t,  0, -1).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3(-t,  0,  1).normalized() * radius\n        };\n\n        // Initial icosahedron faces (20 triangles)\n        std::vector<std::array<idx_t, 3>> faces = {\n            {0, 11, 5}, {0, 5, 1}, {0, 1, 7}, {0, 7, 10}, {0, 10, 11},\n            {1, 5, 9}, {5, 11, 4}, {11, 10, 2}, {10, 7, 6}, {7, 1, 8},\n            {3, 9, 4}, {3, 4, 2}, {3, 2, 6}, {3, 6, 8}, {3, 8, 9},\n            {4, 9, 5}, {2, 4, 11}, {6, 2, 10}, {8, 6, 7}, {9, 8, 1}\n        };\n\n        // Subdivide\n        for (int i = 0; i < subdivisions; ++i) {\n            std::vector<std::array<idx_t, 3>> newFaces;\n            std::map<std::pair<idx_t, idx_t>, idx_t> midpointCache;\n\n            auto getMidpoint = [&](idx_t i1, idx_t i2) -> idx_t {\n                auto key = std::make_pair(std::min(i1, i2), std::max(i1, i2));\n                auto it = midpointCache.find(key);\n                if (it != midpointCache.end()) return it->second;\n\n                Vec3 mid = (vertices[i1] + vertices[i2]) / 2.0f;\n                mid = mid.normalized() * radius;\n                idx_t idx = static_cast<idx_t>(vertices.size());\n                vertices.push_back(mid);\n                midpointCache[key] = idx;\n                return idx;\n            };\n\n            for (const auto& face : faces) {\n                idx_t a = getMidpoint(face[0], face[1]);\n                idx_t b = getMidpoint(face[1], face[2]);\n                idx_t c = getMidpoint(face[2], face[0]);\n\n                newFaces.push_back({face[0], a, c});\n                newFaces.push_back({face[1], b, a});\n                newFaces.push_back({face[2], c, b});\n                newFaces.push_back({a, b, c});\n            }\n            faces = std::move(newFaces);\n        }\n\n        // Build triangles (normals pointing inward for a \"room\")\n        triangles.reserve(faces.size());\n        for (const auto& face : faces) {\n            // Reverse winding to make normals point inward\n            triangles.emplace_back(vertices[face[2]], vertices[face[1]], vertices[face[0]]);\n        }\n    }\n};\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Random Number Generation (counter-based, deterministic under parallelism)\n// ============================================================================\n\n// Stateless splitmix64 hash: every (i, j, ray, component) tuple maps to an\n// independent uniform value, so the Monte-Carlo sampling is identical\n// regardless of how the (i, j) pairs are distributed over ranks/threads/GPUs.\n__host__ __device__ inline uint64_t splitmix64(uint64_t x) {\n    x += 0x9E3779B97F4A7C15ULL;\n    x = (x ^ (x >> 30)) * 0xBF58476D1CE4E5B9ULL;\n    x = (x ^ (x >> 27)) * 0x94D049BB133111EBULL;\n    return x ^ (x >> 31);\n}\n\n__host__ __device__ inline val_t rand01(uint64_t key) {\n    // Top 24 bits -> uniform float in [0, 1)\n    return static_cast<val_t>(splitmix64(key) >> 40) * (1.0f / 16777216.0f);\n}\n\n// Generate a point inside a triangle from two uniform samples (barycentric)\n__host__ __device__ inline Vec3 pointInTriangle(const Triangle& t, val_t u, val_t v) {\n    if (u + v > 1.0f) {\n        u = 1.0f - u;\n        v = 1.0f - v;\n    }\n    Vec3 ab = t.b - t.a;\n    Vec3 ac = t.c - t.a;\n    return t.a + ab * u + ac * v;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Ray-Triangle Intersection (Möller-Trumbore algorithm)\n// ============================================================================\n\n__host__ __device__ val_t rayTriangleIntersect(const Vec3& orig, const Vec3& dir,\n                                               const Vec3& v0, const Vec3& v1, const Vec3& v2) {\n    Vec3 e1 = v1 - v0;\n    Vec3 e2 = v2 - v0;\n    Vec3 pvec = dir.cross(e2);\n    val_t det = e1.dot(pvec);\n\n    if (fabsf(det) < EPSILON) return FLT_MAX;\n\n    val_t invDet = 1.0f / det;\n    Vec3 tvec = orig - v0;\n    val_t u = tvec.dot(pvec) * invDet;\n    if (u < 0.0f || u > 1.0f) return FLT_MAX;\n\n    Vec3 qvec = tvec.cross(e1);\n    val_t v = dir.dot(qvec) * invDet;\n    if (v < 0.0f || u + v > 1.0f) return FLT_MAX;\n\n    return e2.dot(qvec) * invDet;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Visibility Testing (flattened-octree traversal on the GPU)\n// ============================================================================\n\n// Segment-box overlap test against a flattened octree node's AABB\n__device__ inline bool rayIntersectsNode(const GpuNode& n, const Vec3& p1, const Vec3& p2) {\n    Vec3 center{n.cx, n.cy, n.cz};\n    Vec3 halfExtent{n.hx, n.hy, n.hz};\n\n    Vec3 d = (p2 - p1) * 0.5f;\n    Vec3 c = p1 + d - center;\n    Vec3 ad = {fabsf(d.x), fabsf(d.y), fabsf(d.z)};\n\n    if (fabsf(c.x) > halfExtent.x + ad.x) return false;\n    if (fabsf(c.y) > halfExtent.y + ad.y) return false;\n    if (fabsf(c.z) > halfExtent.z + ad.z) return false;\n\n    if (fabsf(d.y * c.z - d.z * c.y) > halfExtent.y * ad.z + halfExtent.z * ad.y + EPSILON) return false;\n    if (fabsf(d.z * c.x - d.x * c.z) > halfExtent.z * ad.x + halfExtent.x * ad.z + EPSILON) return false;\n    if (fabsf(d.x * c.y - d.y * c.x) > halfExtent.x * ad.y + halfExtent.y * ad.x + EPSILON) return false;\n\n    return true;\n}\n\n// Check if a ray between two triangles is blocked by any other triangle,\n// using an explicit-stack traversal of the flattened octree.\n__device__ bool isRayBlocked(const Vec3& from, const Vec3& to,\n                             const GpuNode* nodes, const int* triIdx,\n                             const Triangle* triangles,\n                             int srcTriIdx, int dstTriIdx) {\n    Vec3 dir = to - from;\n    val_t rayLen = dir.norm();\n    if (rayLen < EPSILON) return true;\n    Vec3 dirNorm = dir / rayLen;\n\n    int stack[96];\n    int sp = 0;\n    stack[sp++] = 0;  // root\n\n    while (sp > 0) {\n        const GpuNode& n = nodes[stack[--sp]];\n\n        if (n.triCount > 0) {\n            // Leaf: test triangles directly\n            for (int k = 0; k < n.triCount; ++k) {\n                int idx = triIdx[n.triStart + k];\n                if (idx == srcTriIdx || idx == dstTriIdx) continue;\n\n                const Triangle& tri = triangles[idx];\n                val_t dist = rayTriangleIntersect(from, dirNorm, tri.a, tri.b, tri.c);\n                if (dist > EPSILON && dist < rayLen - EPSILON) {\n                    return true;  // Ray is blocked\n                }\n            }\n        } else {\n            // Internal node: descend into children whose boxes the ray hits\n            for (int cIdx = 0; cIdx < 8; ++cIdx) {\n                int ci = n.child[cIdx];\n                if (ci >= 0 && rayIntersectsNode(nodes[ci], from, to)) {\n                    stack[sp++] = ci;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    return false;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Form Factor Computation (Kij) - CUDA kernel\n// ============================================================================\n\n// Compute the cosine of angle between vector and triangle normal\n__host__ __device__ inline val_t cosPhi(const Vec3& v, const Vec3& normal) {\n    val_t vNorm = v.norm();\n    if (vNorm <= EPSILON) return ZERO;\n    return fmaxf(ZERO, v.dot(normal) / vNorm);\n}\n\n// One thread per (i, j) pair; this rank handles global rows\n// [rowStart, rowStart + numRows).\n__global__ void kijKernel(const Triangle* __restrict__ triangles, int numTriangles,\n                          int rowStart, int numRows,\n                          const GpuNode* __restrict__ nodes,\n                          const int* __restrict__ triIdx,\n                          val_t* __restrict__ kijLocal) {\n    long long tid = static_cast<long long>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;\n    long long total = static_cast<long long>(numRows) * numTriangles;\n    if (tid >= total) return;\n\n    int il = static_cast<int>(tid / numTriangles);\n    int j = static_cast<int>(tid % numTriangles);\n    int i = rowStart + il;\n\n    if (i == j) {\n        kijLocal[tid] = ZERO;\n        return;\n    }\n\n    const Triangle triI = triangles[i];\n    const Triangle triJ = triangles[j];\n\n    // Cull triangles facing the same direction\n    if (triI.normal().dot(triJ.normal()) > 0.99f) {\n        kijLocal[tid] = ZERO;\n        return;\n    }\n\n    val_t kij = ZERO;\n    const uint64_t pairKey =\n        (static_cast<uint64_t>(i) * static_cast<uint64_t>(numTriangles) +\n         static_cast<uint64_t>(j)) * (4ULL * NUM_RAYS);\n\n    for (int r = 0; r < NUM_RAYS; ++r) {\n        uint64_t rayKey = pairKey + 4ULL * r;\n        Vec3 pI = pointInTriangle(triI, rand01(rayKey + 0), rand01(rayKey + 1));\n        Vec3 pJ = pointInTriangle(triJ, rand01(rayKey + 2), rand01(rayKey + 3));\n\n        if (isRayBlocked(pI, pJ, nodes, triIdx, triangles, i, j)) continue;\n\n        Vec3 v = pJ - pI;\n        val_t distSqr = v.squaredNorm();\n        if (distSqr < EPSILON) continue;\n\n        val_t cosPhiI = cosPhi(v, triI.normal());\n        val_t cosPhiJ = cosPhi(-v, triJ.normal());\n\n        if (cosPhiI <= ZERO || cosPhiJ <= ZERO) continue;\n\n        kij += (cosPhiI * cosPhiJ) / (PI * distSqr);\n    }\n\n    kijLocal[tid] = kij * INV_NUM_RAYS;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Tau (time delay) Computation (host, OpenMP)\n// ============================================================================\n\nint computeTau(const Triangle& triI, const Triangle& triJ) {\n    val_t dist = (triI.center() - triJ.center()).norm();\n    return static_cast<int>(std::ceil(dist * INV_WAVE_SPEED));\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Simulation Kernel (Wave Propagation) - one block per local triangle row\n// ============================================================================\n\nconstexpr int SIM_BLOCK = 256;\n\n__global__ void simStepKernel(const val_t* __restrict__ kijLocal,\n                              const int* __restrict__ tauLocal,\n                              const val_t* __restrict__ areas,\n                              const val_t* __restrict__ rho,\n                              const val_t* __restrict__ radE,\n                              val_t* __restrict__ radB,\n                              int numTriangles, int rowStart, int t) {\n    int il = blockIdx.x;\n    int i = rowStart + il;\n\n    const val_t* kRow = kijLocal + static_cast<size_t>(il) * numTriangles;\n    const int* tRow = tauLocal + static_cast<size_t>(il) * numTriangles;\n\n    val_t sum = ZERO;\n    for (int j = threadIdx.x; j < numTriangles; j += blockDim.x) {\n        if (j == i) continue;\n\n        int tauij = tRow[j];\n\n        // Skip if wave hasn't yet propagated from j to i (tau >= 1 for i != j,\n        // so only rows < t of radB are read here)\n        if (t < tauij) continue;\n\n        val_t kij = kRow[j];\n        if (kij <= ZERO) continue;\n\n        // Get radiosity from source triangle at time when emission occurred\n        val_t radJ = radB[static_cast<size_t>(t - tauij) * numTriangles + j];\n        if (radJ <= ZERO) continue;\n\n        // Accumulate contribution: form factor * area * source radiosity\n        sum += fminf(kij * areas[j], ONE) * radJ;\n    }\n\n    __shared__ val_t sdata[SIM_BLOCK];\n    sdata[threadIdx.x] = sum;\n    __syncthreads();\n    for (int s = blockDim.x / 2; s > 0; s >>= 1) {\n        if (threadIdx.x < s) sdata[threadIdx.x] += sdata[threadIdx.x + s];\n        __syncthreads();\n    }\n\n    // Update radiosity: reflection + emission\n    if (threadIdx.x == 0) {\n        radB[static_cast<size_t>(t) * numTriangles + i] =\n            rho[i] * sdata[0] + radE[static_cast<size_t>(t) * numTriangles + i];\n    }\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Distance Kernels (Cross-Correlation)\n// ============================================================================\n\n// One thread per (local row, lag): discrete cross-correlation against the\n// source triangle's radiosity time series.\n__global__ void corrKernel(const val_t* __restrict__ radB,\n                           int numTriangles, int numTimesteps,\n                           int rowStart, int numRows, int sourceIndex,\n                           val_t* __restrict__ corr) {\n    long long tid = static_cast<long long>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;\n    long long total = static_cast<long long>(numRows) * numTimesteps;\n    if (tid >= total) return;\n\n    int il = static_cast<int>(tid / numTimesteps);\n    int t = static_cast<int>(tid % numTimesteps);\n    int i = rowStart + il;\n\n    val_t sum = ZERO;\n    for (int tt = t; tt < numTimesteps; ++tt) {\n        val_t pB = radB[static_cast<size_t>(tt) * numTriangles + i];\n        val_t pS = radB[static_cast<size_t>(tt - t) * numTriangles + sourceIndex];\n        sum += pS * pB;\n    }\n    corr[tid] = sum;\n}\n\n// One thread per local row: pick the earliest lag with the strictly largest\n// correlation (same tie-breaking as the sequential code).\n__global__ void argmaxKernel(const val_t* __restrict__ corr, int numTimesteps,\n                             int numRows, val_t* __restrict__ distLocal) {\n    int il = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;\n    if (il >= numRows) return;\n\n    const val_t* row = corr + static_cast<size_t>(il) * numTimesteps;\n    val_t maxCorr = ZERO;\n    int bestT = 0;\n    for (int t = 0; t < numTimesteps; ++t) {\n        if (row[t] > maxCorr) {\n            maxCorr = row[t];\n            bestT = t;\n        }\n    }\n    distLocal[il] = WAVE_SPEED * static_cast<val_t>(bestT);\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Room Response Simulation State\n// ============================================================================\n\nstruct SimulationState {\n    size_t numTriangles;\n    size_t numTimesteps;\n\n    std::vector<Triangle> triangles;\n    std::vector<val_t> areas;       // Area of each triangle\n    std::vector<val_t> rho;         // Reflectivity (0.0 to 1.0)\n    std::vector<val_t> kij;         // Form factors (local rows x N, row-major)\n    std::vector<int> tau;           // Time delays (local rows x N, row-major)\n    std::vector<val_t> radE;        // Emission radiosity (T x N matrix)\n    std::vector<val_t> radB;        // Reflected radiosity (T x N matrix, full copy)\n    std::vector<val_t> distances;   // Computed distances from source (full)\n\n    Octree octree;                  // Spatial acceleration structure\n\n    size_t sourceIndex;\n\n    // MPI decomposition: this rank owns global rows [rowStart, rowStart+rowCount)\n    int mpiRank = 0;\n    int mpiSize = 1;\n    int rowStart = 0;\n    int rowCount = 0;\n    std::vector<int> rowCounts;     // per-rank row counts\n    std::vector<int> rowDispls;     // per-rank row offsets\n\n    // Device buffers (one GPU per rank)\n    Triangle* dTriangles = nullptr;\n    GpuNode* dNodes = nullptr;\n    int* dTriIdx = nullptr;\n    val_t* dAreas = nullptr;\n    val_t* dRho = nullptr;\n    val_t* dKij = nullptr;          // local rows x N\n    int* dTau = nullptr;            // local rows x N\n    val_t* dRadE = nullptr;         // T x N\n    val_t* dRadB = nullptr;         // T x N\n    val_t* dCorr = nullptr;         // local rows x T\n    val_t* dDist = nullptr;         // local rows\n\n    size_t idxLocal2d(size_t il, size_t j) const { return il * numTriangles + j; }\n    size_t idxTN(size_t t, size_t n) const { return t * numTriangles + n; }\n};\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Initialization\n// ============================================================================\n\nvoid initializeSimulation(SimulationState& state, int subdivisions, size_t timesteps,\n                          size_t sourceIdx, val_t reflectivity) {\n    const bool root = (state.mpiRank == 0);\n\n    // Generate mesh (deterministic, so every rank builds an identical copy)\n    IcosphereMesh mesh(subdivisions, 10.0f);  // Radius 10 units\n    state.triangles = std::move(mesh.triangles);\n    state.numTriangles = state.triangles.size();\n    state.numTimesteps = timesteps;\n    state.sourceIndex = sourceIdx % state.numTriangles;\n\n    if (root) printf(\"Generated icosphere mesh with %zu triangles\\n\", state.numTriangles);\n\n    // Block-distribute triangle rows across MPI ranks\n    int n = static_cast<int>(state.numTriangles);\n    int base = n / state.mpiSize;\n    int rem = n % state.mpiSize;\n    state.rowCounts.resize(state.mpiSize);\n    state.rowDispls.resize(state.mpiSize);\n    for (int r = 0; r < state.mpiSize; ++r) {\n        state.rowCounts[r] = base + (r < rem ? 1 : 0);\n        state.rowDispls[r] = r * base + std::min(r, rem);\n    }\n    state.rowStart = state.rowDispls[state.mpiRank];\n    state.rowCount = state.rowCounts[state.mpiRank];\n\n    // Build octree for spatial acceleration\n    if (root) printf(\"Building octree...\\n\");\n    state.octree.build(state.triangles);\n\n    // Initialize areas\n    state.areas.resize(state.numTriangles);\n    #pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n        state.areas[i] = state.triangles[i].area();\n    }\n\n    // Initialize reflectivity\n    state.rho.resize(state.numTriangles, reflectivity);\n\n    // Initialize matrices (Kij and Tau hold only this rank's rows)\n    state.kij.resize(static_cast<size_t>(state.rowCount) * state.numTriangles, ZERO);\n    state.tau.resize(static_cast<size_t>(state.rowCount) * state.numTriangles, 0);\n    state.radE.resize(timesteps * state.numTriangles, ZERO);\n    state.radB.resize(timesteps * state.numTriangles, ZERO);\n    state.distances.resize(state.numTriangles, ZERO);\n\n    // Set source emission (active for first half of timesteps)\n    size_t timeOn = 0;\n    size_t timeOff = timesteps / 2;\n    for (size_t t = timeOn; t < timeOff; ++t) {\n        state.radE[state.idxTN(t, state.sourceIndex)] = 1.0f;\n    }\n}\n\n// Upload static data and allocate working buffers on this rank's GPU\nvoid setupDevice(SimulationState& state) {\n    size_t n = state.numTriangles;\n    size_t t = state.numTimesteps;\n    size_t localRows = static_cast<size_t>(state.rowCount);\n\n    // Flatten octree for GPU traversal\n    std::vector<GpuNode> nodes;\n    std::vector<int> triIdx;\n    flattenOctree(state.octree, nodes, triIdx);\n\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&state.dTriangles, n * sizeof(Triangle)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&state.dNodes, nodes.size() * sizeof(GpuNode)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&state.dTriIdx, std::max<size_t>(triIdx.size(), 1) * sizeof(int)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&state.dAreas, n * sizeof(val_t)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&state.dRho, n * sizeof(val_t)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&state.dKij, std::max<size_t>(localRows * n, 1) * sizeof(val_t)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&state.dTau, std::max<size_t>(localRows * n, 1) * sizeof(int)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&state.dRadE, t * n * sizeof(val_t)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&state.dRadB, t * n * sizeof(val_t)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&state.dCorr, std::max<size_t>(localRows * t, 1) * sizeof(val_t)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&state.dDist, std::max<size_t>(localRows, 1) * sizeof(val_t)));\n\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(state.dTriangles, state.triangles.data(),\n                          n * sizeof(Triangle), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(state.dNodes, nodes.data(),\n                          nodes.size() * sizeof(GpuNode), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n    if (!triIdx.empty()) {\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(state.dTriIdx, triIdx.data(),\n
